title: Guide Your Audience: Signposting and Transitions
objective: Students learn phrases that help listeners follow a scientific presentation.
context: Talk notes: We watched frogs. We visited two ponds. One pond had a higher count. We want to visit again.

items.prompt: Introduce your topic and preview the talk.
items.answer: Accept an opening that names frogs, ponds and the plan.
items.hint: Try: First I will explain ___. Then I will show ___.

items.prompt: Write one line to move from your method to the finding.
items.answer: Example: Now that you know how we counted frogs, let us look at the two pond counts.
items.hint: Connect a completed step to the next step.

items.prompt: Close with a summary and a next step.
items.answer: One pond had more frogs on this visit. We plan to visit again.
